iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 40 of US-Israel war on Iran (since Feb 28 2026). Bushehr nuclear-adjacent infrastructure struck Apr 5. Natanz & Fordow previously damaged Jun 2025. Iran at 60% enrichment with massive unaccounted HEU stockpile. Ceasefire rejected Apr 6. Putin warned US-Israel. Technical: CRITICAL | Rhetoric: HIGH | Mobilization: HIGH

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 40. US-Israel strikes escalating — Hegseth: largest volume Apr 7. Iran hit petrochemical Mahshahr, Bushehr perimeter, missile/UAV sites. Iran struck back at US bases in Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi, UAE. Hormuz deadline in effect; Strait threatened. Pezeshkian rejected ceasefire: 'blatant terrorism'. Cyber warfare escalating.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Ceasefire fully collapsed. Israel expanding southern Lebanon invasion. Apr 5: Israeli strike on Ain Saadeh (outside Hezbollah zone) killed civilians incl. 15-yr-old. Jnah area strike killed 5 (incl. Sudanese nationals). Ground invasion ongoing — Dahiyeh residents fleeing. Israel setting tempo of conflict.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: FM Fidan: Turkey could be pulled into nuclear arms race if Iran acquires weapons. Strategic ambiguity policy — signals red lines without explicit declaration. Akkuyu nuclear plant commissioning 2026 — dual-use capability building. NATO B61-12 gravity bombs replacing older variants; Turkey excluded from oversight.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: CFR report: armed conflict between India-Pakistan likely 2026 due to Kashmir terrorism. Operation Sindoor precision strikes May 2025 in response to Pahalgam attack. Both nuclear-armed states continuing military buildup. US intel warns nuclear conflict possible. No new escalation Apr 8.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: New START expired Feb 4 2026. No replacement in sight. Putin nuclear doctrine: use permitted against large-scale conventional attacks on Russia. Russia standing with Iran — warned US-Israel on nuclear facility targeting. Ongoing Russia-Ukraine war continues to drive nuclear signaling.

china.name: China
china.notes: ISW/AEI China-Taiwan Update Apr 3 2026: No significant PLA activity changes. Taiwan Strait stable. KMT visiting China. Han Kuang exercises ongoing (Apr 2). Trump's Iran focus may be reducing Beijing's appetite for Taiwan pressure. US intel still does not expect Taiwan invasion 2027.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: DPRK declared nuclear status 'irreversible' Apr 7 2026. Multiple ballistic missiles fired Apr 7 — second event in 2 days. KN-14 solid ICBM: operational. Submarine missile test imminent (maintenance complete). Kim Jong Un observed 600mm rocket launcher tests Mar 14-15 with daughter Kim Ju Ae. Warship cruise missile tests ongoing.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4. Russia-Ukraine ongoing — ISW Offensive Campaign Assessment Apr 4-5 2026. GCRI: nuclear escalation risk if Russia perceives failure. Hybrid warfare intensifying. Russian disinformation about Ukrainian bombs (Apr 2026). No negotiated settlement in sight. NATO continued support.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan declared 'open war' on Afghanistan Feb 27. First direct Pakistani attacks on Taliban government in Kabul & Kandahar. Afghan Taliban open to China-mediated talks (Urumqi). TTP/Al-Qaeda safe haven in Afghanistan remains flashpoint. Diplomatic track active but fragile.
